source_caveats: No canonical actualbudget/actual match in public 200 native repo catalog; no explicit Actual Budget identity in 50 Web homepage audit.
Web contains 44 synthetic references plus 6 public websites per paper; 44 synthetic identities are not presumed hidden original commercial sites.
Shared components, template ancestry and near-duplicates remain unresolved; generic React/Vite alone is not a source-family match.
Actual is finance-domain GUI, while many Web tests are content/catalog/marketing pages. Capability correspondence is a study hypothesis, not gain evidence.
Reference-source archive is researcher-side infrastructure; actor sees only protocol-allowed public observation and own code, never benchmark private assertions.
